script: [serious] March 13th, 1962. America's top general signs a plan... to attack America. Not for real. To fake it. The plan was called Operation Northwoods, and the memo still exists. Stage a terror campaign in Miami. Explode a few plastic bombs in "carefully chosen spots." Fake hijackings. Blow up a U.S. ship in Guantanamo Bay... and blame Cuba. [whispers] It even suggests funerals... for mock victims. Why? In their own words, casualty lists in U.S. newspapers would cause "a helpful wave of national indignation." The goal was a reason to invade Cuba. President Kennedy said no. That same year, the general who signed it was out as America's top officer. And the memo? Kept secret for thirty-five years, until 1997. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number one. Which file should we open next?
